Title: MudBlazor Migration - Cyrena.Components.Core
Content:
## MudBlazor Migration Status: Cyrena.Components.Core

### Date: In Progress
### Goal: Remove Bootstrap CSS / BootstrapBlazor, migrate to MudBlazor

---

### Changes Made in Cyrena.Components.Core

#### 1. `_Imports.razor`
- **Removed**: `@using BootstrapBlazor.Components`
- **Added**: `@using MudBlazor`

#### 2. `ConnectionSelector.razor`
- **Replaced**: Bootstrap `<select>` with `form-label`, `form-control`, `mb-3` classes
- **Now Uses**: `MudSelect` with `MudSelectItem` components
- **Features**: Outlined variant, dense mode, cable icon adornment
- **Binding**: Uses `@bind-Value` for two-way binding with `ValueChanged` event callback

#### 3. `ConnectionSelector.razor.cs`
- **No code changes needed** - `@bind-Value` handles the event callback automatically

#### 4. `PluginSelector.razor`
- **Replaced**: Bootstrap `form-check`, `form-check-input`, `form-check-label`, `mb-3`, `p-2` classes
- **Now Uses**: `MudPaper`, `MudText`, `MudStack`, `MudCheckBox` components
- **Features**: Primary color, dense mode, proper disabled state handling
- **Binding**: Uses explicit `Value` + `ValueChanged` pattern for checkbox events

#### 5. `PluginSelector.razor.cs`
- **Added**: `OnSelectionChanged(PluginSelect item, bool value)` method to handle MudBlazor checkbox events
- **Updated**: `_models` initialization to use `new()` instead of `default!`

---

### Files Already Using MudBlazor (No Changes Needed)
- `DialogServiceExtensions.cs` - Already uses MudBlazor IDialogService

### Files with No UI Framework Dependencies (No Changes Needed)
- `CodeInput.razor` - Uses BlazorMonaco only
- `KernelComponentBase.cs` - Pure component base class
- All contracts (IDockingService, IShortcut, IToolbarComponent, IViewStartProvider)
- All options (ComponentOptions, CodeLanguages)
- All extensions (ComponentBaseExtensions, CyrenaBuilderExtensions, CyrenaKernelBuilderExtensions)
- `KernelInjectAttribute.cs`
- `IWindowHandle.cs`, `ViewStart.cs`

---

### Remaining Work
- [ ] Remove BootstrapBlazor package reference from .csproj (if present)
- [ ] Verify no other Bootstrap CSS classes remain in any files
- [ ] Test components render correctly with MudBlazor theme
- [ ] Update consuming projects to ensure MudBlazor theme is configured

### Notes
- MudBlazor package is already referenced in the .csproj
- No BootstrapBlazor package reference was found in the .csproj (already removed or never present)
- The project uses `MudBlazor` and `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web` packages
